definitions.intervention_rule: a predictively intervened trajectory is inadmissible for offline counterfactual EWT

limitations: Synthetic timing cases demonstrate arithmetic and refusal behavior only.
Real EWT and AIW remain NOT_ESTIMABLE while eligible physical runs are zero.
An estimable EWT would not establish AIW or physical actionability.
Negative EWT values are legitimate late-warning results and are preserved.

limitations: The fixture is deterministic synthetic software control; it does not approximate real thermal performance.
Eight pair groups and four folds are a software-control population, not a physical experiment population.
Feature windows are correlated; fold AP values are not independent samples, so no confidence interval or physical effect size is computed.
Sample/window AP and event-level metrics use different units and are never pooled into one unlabeled score.
Synthetic AP=1.0 does not show that XGBoost physically outperforms Controller A or any baseline.
